subject: Pilot hosting request — Greenwich confidential model
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@greenwich.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot hosting + audit request for Greenwich confidential model

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Greenwich is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the private deployment options. We're preparing an internal pilot that will process PII and model inputs tied to UK customer records. Before we proceed I'd like to confirm a few non-standard requirements so procurement and security can sign off: 

- In-country data residency (UK region) + guarantee that derived vectors and artifacts remain within the customer VPC.
- Customer-controlled KMS (we'd like to bring our CMKs / HSM).
- Quarterly on-site audit rights for our security team for the first 12 months (two auditors, up to one business day each visit) to validate logging, access controls, and KV-cache handling.
- A 30% one-year committed usage discount to offset integration / compliance costs.

Can Redwood support these as part of a 12-month pilot? If so, please send a proposed SOW and any gating conditions we should expect. Procurement has attached our standard Pilot Terms (procurement@greenwich.ai).

Thanks — Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Product Security, Greenwich AI
Attachments: procurement_pilot_template.pdf (referenced)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@greenwich.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot hosting + audit request for Greenwich confidential model

Hi Elena — appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front and then a couple of notes from our side: 

- In-country residency (UK): Yes — we can place the private deployment into a UK-only VPC and limit egress per the contract.
- Customer KMS: Supported; we typically integrate a customer-managed CMK with an HSM-backed provider, will need a key-rotation & escrow discussion.
- Quarterly on-site audits: This is the one we need to iron out. Our standard approach for Private/VPC pilots is a single escorted on-site review during the first 12 months (remote evidence + one on-site visit). Quarterly in-person access increases operational risk and requires an exception.
- 30% discount: That exceeds standard Deal Desk bands. We can usually offer a 15–20% committed-use credit for a 12-month pilot plus an integration fee waiver in some cases, but anything above that requires executive approval.

I'll attach a draft SOW and a short risk matrix that highlights what we can allow versus what needs legal/exec signoff. To move quickly, can you confirm Greenwich will accept: (a) customer CMK with explicit restrictions on key usage (no export), (b) a single escorted on-site audit limited to log and controls review (not raw KV cache access), and (c) a 20% committed-use discount with a one-time integration fee of $15k? If yes, I'll escalate internally for an approvals decision and route redlines back to you.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachments: greenwich_sow_draft.pdf (SOW draft), risk_matrix.xlsx (summary)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot hosting + audit request for Greenwich confidential model — exec approval requested

LAUREN / RISHI — forwarding Greenwich's ask and my proposed concession set. TL;DR: Greenwich wants UK residency + bring-your-own-CMK (ok), quarterly on-site audits (exception request), and 30% discount (above band). I recommend we approve the following concesssions to close the pilot quickly: 

- Discount: 20% committed-usage credit for 12 months (deal economics attached: pricing_workup.xlsx) — requires final sign-off from you for any >18% concession.
- Audit: Approve one escorted on-site audit during the first 12 months limited to (A) control review, (B) redacted logs and procedures — explicitly disallow direct KV-cache or raw dataset extraction. Any additional requests must go through legal and may be denied.
- KMS: Allow customer CMK (HSM) with requirement that Redwood never has key export rights; Redwood to provide key-usage logs for audits.
- One-time integration fee: $15,000 to cover cloud region setup and compliance packaging; we can waive up to $10k for 20%+ discount.

Attachments included: greenwich_sow_draft.pdf, risk_matrix.xlsx, pricing_workup.xlsx

Request: Please confirm (A) discount ceiling we can approve (18% vs 20%), and (B) whether we can commit to the single escorted audit scope above. If you approve, I'll finalize the SOW and have legal prepare limited-audit language and NDAs for the on-site team.

Thanks — Monica
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot hosting + audit request for Greenwich confidential model — exec approval requested

Monica — thanks for the clear recommendation and materials. I agree we should be pragmatic to win this pilot but preserve our risk posture. Approvals below: 

1) Discount: Approve up to 18% committed-use credit for a 12-month pilot. Anything beyond 18% requires VP approval. Document concession in the Deal Desk record (HubSpot) and reflect impact to ARR in the pricing_workup.

2) Audit scope: Approve one escorted on-site audit during the first 12 months limited to: 
   - Review of access-control procedures, logging configuration, and SOC2-aligned evidence.
   - Delivery of redacted logs and aggregated telemetry only; no export of KV cache or raw customer data.
   - Strict requirement for sign-off on an on-site rules-of-engagement form and a pre-approved list of personnel.

3) KMS: Approve customer-managed CMK (HSM) integration under the condition that Redwood maintains a tamper-evident key-usage log for the duration of the pilot and that keys are never exportable. Legal to add clause requiring remediation timeline for any suspicious access.

4) Integration fee: Waive up to $10k, remaining $5k to be paid on signature.

Next steps: Monica, please (A) finalize the SOW to include the limited-audit language, (B) loop in Legal to prepare the rules-of-engagement and key escrow language, and (C) update HubSpot with the finalized concession set and pricing. Once Legal signs off, send final SOW to Elena for procurement review.

I'll copy the Deal Desk on the final doc.

— Lauren
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
